name: Cambria County, PA
findings: Cambria County has 549 nonprofit organizations. 229 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 187 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cambria County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
